data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Thank you for reaching out and bringing this to our attention. This is a known UI display bug where the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again, as a permanent fix will be released in the next patch. [T-825] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
